Fruit Salad With Cooked Dressing
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 5, 2009 - 11:50pm

Ingredients




1 cup sugar
2 1/2 tablespoons PLAIN flour
Pinch of salt

Preparation

1 Combine equal portions of apple, salted peanuts and banana. Set aside. 2 Mix until smooth. Now add: 1/4 tsp. mustard 1/4 c. vinegar 3/4 c. water 3 Mix and cook on low heat until thick. Add 2 tablespoons butter and let cool. Pour over fruit and mix. (Dressing is great over other fruit salads and as fruit dip.)
